# Security Policy

## Supported versions

Security fixes are applied to the latest add-on version on the default branch.
Please update to the latest release before reporting an issue that may already
have been fixed.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Do not open a public issue for a suspected vulnerability. Instead, use
[GitHub's private vulnerability reporting][security-advisory].

Include as much of the following as possible:

- The affected add-on and Tautulli versions.
- The Home Assistant deployment and access mode, such as ingress or a direct
  port.
- Reproduction steps, expected impact, and any known mitigation.
- Relevant logs with tokens, passwords, hostnames, IP addresses, and personal
  media information removed.

The maintainer will acknowledge the report, investigate it, and coordinate a
fix and disclosure where appropriate. Vulnerabilities in Tautulli itself may
need to be reported to the upstream project as part of that process.

[security-advisory]: https://github.com/manix84/addon-tautulli/security/advisories/new
